subject: Pilot demo scheduling — capex window & travel blackout
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@veridianhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot slot before capex lock?

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick conversation this morning. The team at Veridian is keen to see a short pilot demo of Redwood to validate inference economics on our clinical summarization flow. We are trying to line this up in the next week because our CapEx committee meets on May 28 and finance wants a rough TCO to include in the packet.

Proposed slot: Thursday 21 May, 10:00–11:00 PT. Attendees would be myself, our Lead PM (cc'd procurement afterwards once we move forward), and one data science manager.

Can you confirm availability? If not, alternative windows: Tue 19 (afternoon PT) or Wed 20 (mornings). We are flexible but would prefer something before May 28 if possible.

Appreciate it —
Samir
Director of Product
Veridian Health
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Rao <samir@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot slot before capex lock?

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and great to hear there is momentum around the packet. Quick update on our side: our technical lead who would run the live KV-cache/latency section is on a week-long sales roadshow starting May 20 and won't be reliably available until the week of June 9.

We don't want to give Veridian a half-baked demo without the KV caching and batching pieces — those are the features where we can show clear cost delta for clinical workloads. Two options that would respect your CapEx timing:

1) We can do an asynchronous pre-recorded 25-min walkthrough targeted at your finance and PM stakeholders this week (we'll include token-level cost breakdowns and a short appendix with expected TCO ranges). I can send the recording + a one-pager today to include in the packet.

2) Schedule a live, hands-on demo the week of June 9 (we're holding June 10, 11 open) so the proper technical lead can present and take deep questions.

If you absolutely need something included in the May 28 packet, option 1 will get you the artifacts (recording + one-pager + sample token breakdown). Otherwise, option 2 gives you the full live session and Q&A.

I've attached a one-pager and a short example cost table.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and who on procurement should receive the artifact if you go with option 1.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_onepager.pdf (1.2MB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot slot before capex lock? (internal)

Laura / Marissa —

If Veridian wants artifacts for the packet, let's prioritize the recording + a short cost appendix. I can cut the recording into two parts: (A) product walkthrough (15m) and (B) cost deep-dive (10m). Marissa, can your solutions engineer annotate the cost appendix with the expected batch sizes and sequence length assumptions for clinical notes? That will make the CapEx line look credible.

If we go live in June, I recommend we offer an optional short PO template and a procurement-ready SOW so procurement has clear next steps. We should also flag that June 10 is our preferred live slot — it's when both infra and solutions leads are available.

Agree on including a short appendix that states the assumptions explicitly (model variant, quantization, expected tokens per call) — that prevents surprises in the packet.

Ben
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@veridianhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: 2025-05-20T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot slot before capex lock?

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the one-pager (received). We reviewed both options with the PM and Finance — good call on the recording for the packet. Please send the recording and the annotated cost appendix today and I'll include it in our May 28 CapEx packet.

Separately, we are happy to schedule the live demo on June 10 at 10:00 PT so our DS manager can join after travel. Please send a calendar invite with the proposed agenda and the SOW/PO template so procurement (cc'd) can start the paperwork.

Procurement contact: procurement@veridianhealth.com
Requested attachments for procurement: procurement_questionnaire.xlsx, draft-SOW-redwood.pdf

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Samir
Director of Product, Veridian Health
